bio: In a busy pedestrian street in the city centre, chef Yugo Ishikawa has set up shop in this elongated, minimalist-style restaurant. He throws himself body and soul into his painstakingly crafted dishes from the traditional Japanese cuisine he so loves. On the daily specials board: tonkatsu shoulder of pork in breadcrumbs, tuna tataki with ponzu oroshi, tsukemono pickled vegetables. Simpler delicious options at lunchtime. You almost feel like you are in an izakaya in Tokyo. A hit....
